timeline.summary: Flashback: Taigam, taught by Narset, leaves the Jeskai and travels to Purugir seeking work, drawing Sultai interest.
timeline.quote: He didn't set out to join another clan.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Jeskai monks kill the departing guard and burst into the ship to assassinate Taigam.
timeline.quote: Three human Jeskai monks stood with clenched fists.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ebirri fights the monks and kills two while Taigam, freeing himself, stabs the rakshasa, who then crushes a monk's head; Ebirri reminds Taigam he owns him.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Taigam learns that Narset sent the surviving monk, has the monk crushed, and suspects the monks were zealots acting without her.
timeline.quote: They were zealots, most likely acting without her knowledge.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Taigam resolves to handle the Jeskai threat himself and has the dead monks sized for golden uniforms.
timeline.quote: Taigam signaled the sibsig to keep the boat moving as he began to size the intact dead monks for golden uniforms.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Narset meditates among a hundred monks in the plaza, outwardly serene while her mind races.
timeline.quote: But just because I look quiet and serene doesn't mean I am.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Narset ends the session by reciting a traditional saying that she privately dislikes.
timeline.quote: Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment,

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Without the naga's necromancy, the zombies disperse or crumble, and soldiers desert as Abzan and Jeskai raids grow.
timeline.quote: The months since had been one long slide into a perfect fulfillment of those prophetic words.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Ojutai declares through his aven translator that the Jeskai are no more, orders every ghostfire warrior killed, and commands Quan to erase the names of the clans.
timeline.quote: As of this day, there are no more clans. There are no more khans.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Elspeth dives into the dragon's mouth and drives her sword into its skull as monks rescue the children.
timeline.quote: Elspeth dove headfirst into the open maw, sword held out like a beacon.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 2: Omens" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The wounded dragon flees to the deck and then off the ship while skyriders engage it.
timeline.quote: It began to writhe back, struggling to escape its attackers

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 2: Omens" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset tells Elspeth the Jeskai cannot help, then reveals she will go herself.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 2: Omens" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset persuades an impatient Elspeth to wait one more hour, explaining the Jeskai-Abzan tension over the dead.
timeline.quote: Dromoka all but informed the Abzan that their clan would be eradicated if they didn't forswear their ancestral worship.
